record.one_liner: All-in-one CRM and marketing automation platform for agencies and small businesses (contacts, conversations, calendars, pipelines, payments, funnels, white-label SaaS).
record.auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 authorization-code flow for Marketplace apps (access token about 24h, rotating refresh token, agency and location token types, no PKCE). Private Integration Tokens (static, scope-limited, shown once) for internal use, sent as a Bearer token. Legacy API keys (V1) are being phased out, and V1 reached end-of-support on 2025-12-31. The remote MCP server uses a HighLevel login sign-in and no token.
record.access_notes: A developer account for building Marketplace apps is a sign-up with phone and email verification. The fetched page does not say whether it needs a paid plan, and I found no free-tier statement. HighLevel's support article lists API access on Starter ($97/mo), Unlimited ($297/mo) and Founder ($497/mo). OAuth and PIT are available on all three. Some endpoints are restricted on lower tiers, and Create Sub-Account and Enable SaaS are Founder-only. I did not confirm whether a free developer account can call the API against a live sub-account, or whether a free trial exists. Public Marketplace listing requires approval, but the approval criteria were not on the fetched pages. Private apps and PITs avoid that. Rate limits: 100 requests per 10 seconds and 200,000 per day, per app per resource.
record.blocker: API access needs a paid HighLevel plan (Starter or higher). I could not confirm any free or trial path. Higher-tier endpoints are restricted by plan. Public distribution needs Marketplace app approval. Rate limits apply. Legacy V1 and API keys are end-of-support.
